title: feat(spec): ServiceSlotContracts types the webhooks and trigger-api slots
body:
Fixes #22848
Clause-②: yes (widening: a published type gains two keys)

> ~~Held out of the merge queue by #22949.~~ Released 2026-10-12: #22949 closed, and `main` was merged into this branch with the net diff unchanged. The seat queues it once the new head is green and its remaining pre-queue items are met.

## What changes

`ServiceSlotContracts` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/core-service-contracts.ts`) gains two entries:

- `webhooks: IWebhookService`. `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` registers this slot: `WebhookOutboxPlugin` (`webhook-outbox-plugin.ts:411`) registers an occupant declared as `const service: IWebhookService`.
- `'trigger-api': ITriggerApiService`. `@objectstack/trigger-api` registers this slot: `ApiTriggerPlugin` (`plugin.ts:169`) registers an occupant declared as `const service: ITriggerApiService`.

Both providers already type the occupant as the contract. So the registration itself meets the file's evidence bar ("an entry is a claim, made only where the binding is established"). Neither slot is a `CoreServiceName` member, so both entries go in `ServiceSlotContracts` and not in `CoreServiceContracts`. Each entry has TSDoc naming the contract and the package that registers it.

This is type information only. No runtime file changes. No generated artifact changes: `check:generated` reports all 14 up to date at HEAD `63710c5572`.

## The pin (the card's "Done when")

The pin is in `core-service-contracts.test.ts`, which `check:test-typecheck` compiles.

- **The two probes.** The test declares a lookup with the runtime's keyed signature: a `K extends keyof ServiceSlotContracts` name in, `ServiceSlotContract` of `K` (or `undefined`) out. That is the shape of `DomainHandlerDeps.resolveService` and `getRequestKernelService`. Through it, `getService('webhooks')?.handleRedeliver` is pinned to `IWebhookService['handleRedeliver']`, and `getService('trigger-api')?.handleInboundHook` to `ITriggerApiService['handleInboundHook']`. Each slot is pinned to its contract or `undefined`.
- **CONTROL: other slots.** The same lookup still answers `IHttpServer`, `ISecurityService` and `IDataEngine` (each or `undefined`) for `http.server`, `security` and `data`. The existing pins are untouched and green: `protocol` and `mcp` are `unknown`, `objectql` is the full engine, and `http-server` is the alias.
- **CONTROL: exact key set.** The test "holds exactly the non-core slots whose contract is written" used to check only a subset: an array typed as the key union, plus a length. It is now exact at the type level. `keyof ServiceSlotContracts` minus the core keys must equal the seven listed keys. A key added or dropped without updating the list is a type error.

The new pins use `expectTypeOf`, not local `type _X` aliases. The file's existing aliases are recorded as TS6196 debt in `test-typecheck-debt.json`, and new aliases would have grown that shrink-only ledger. The ledger is unchanged: 52 files / 246 errors / 135 signatures.

## Ablation (spec pin)

The fix was committed first (`9fe6996719`). Then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, which restores automatically) deleted `webhooks: IWebhookService;` from `core-service-contracts.ts` and ran `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:test-typecheck`.

- **The mutation landed.** Anchor count 1 → 0, blob `13ce41bf32ee` → `80becbb0dba7`.
- **The run went RED** (exit 1). Six new error signatures appeared, all in `core-service-contracts.test.ts`:
  - TS2345 ×3: `"webhooks"` is not assignable to `keyof ServiceSlotContracts`;
  - TS2339: `handleRedeliver` does not exist;
  - TS2344 ×2: the slot-type pin and the exact-key-set pin.
- **The restore held.** Blob equals HEAD (`13ce41bf32ee`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Reverse verification: the runtime reads the rebuilt declarations

The 36-package dependency closure of the four consumers was built: `turbo build`, concurrency 2, 36 of 36 succeeded. Then `ablation-replace` (WRAP) inserted one line at `packages/runtime/src/domains/webhooks.ts`. The line reads a member that does not exist, `notAMember`, from the uncast `deps.resolveService(context, WEBHOOKS_SLOT, …)` result. The command was `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec tsc --noEmit`.

- **The mutation landed.** Anchor 1 → 0, blob `c920bff6c2bd` → `6aaa357c3a81`.
- **The run went RED with exactly one error.** `src/domains/webhooks.ts(115,17): error TS2339: Property 'notAMember' does not exist on type 'IWebhookService'`. A stale declaration set has no `webhooks` key. There the lookup would fall to the `string` overload, which answers `any`, and the line would compile.
- **The restore held.** Blob equals HEAD (`c920bff6c2bd`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **A first attempt was a no-op.** Its replacement contained the anchor again, so `ablation-replace` refused it (anchor 1 → 1) before running tsc. Its exit 1 is not a reading, and the run above is the corrected one.

## Readings at BASE `7de0265fc7`

1. **How the map types lookups.** `ServiceSlotContracts` extends `CoreServiceContracts`, and quoted kebab keys already exist (`'http-server'`). `ServiceSlotContract` of `K` answers the entry, or `unknown` when there is none.
   - Three runtime seams are keyed by the map:
     - `DomainHandlerDeps.resolveService` (`domain-handler-registry.ts:182`, with an untyped `string` overload at `:183`);
     - `getRequestKernelService` (`:299` / `:300`);
     - the execution-context resolver (`resolve-execution-context.ts:57`).
   - `ObjectKernel.getService` (`packages/core/src/kernel.ts:816`) is generic over a caller-chosen `T`, takes `name: string` and returns `T`. It does not read the map. So the card's "`kernel.getService('webhooks')` is typed" holds for the runtime's keyed lookups, not for the kernel accessor.
   - The existing slot-typing tests are in `core-service-contracts.test.ts`, which is where the new pin went.
2. **The contracts.** `IWebhookService.handleRedeliver?` (`webhook-service.ts:96`) and `ITriggerApiService.handleInboundHook?` (`trigger-api-service.ts:148`). The contracts barrel exports both (`contracts/index.ts:36`, `:66`).
3. **Registrations.** Both slots are registered (see "What changes"), and each occupant is declared as the contract it is now keyed to. No registration fails to satisfy its interface. `ctx.registerService(name: string, …)` does not read the map either, so no registration is re-checked.
4. **Callers.** Two callers resolve these slots through the typed seam: `runtime/src/domains/webhooks.ts:114` and `runtime/src/domains/automation-hooks.ts:120`. Both still compile. Each casts to `Pick` of the contract's one member, or `undefined`, and that cast is now redundant (see Acceptance notes). Three test files call `kernel.getService` with an explicit `IWebhookService` or `ITriggerApiService` generic: `webhook-redeliver-member.test.ts:189`, `hono-webhooks-redeliver.conformance.test.ts:174` and `inbound-hook-member.test.ts:169`. The map does not affect them. The pinned objectui checkout (`4997995022`) has zero hits for `ServiceSlotContract` or `CoreServiceContract`; the control grep for `@objectstack/spec` hits.
5. **What `check:generated` regenerates.** Nothing. All 14 artifacts are current, and `check:api-surface` reports the public API surface unchanged: the snapshot records that an export exists, not its members.

## Verification (HEAD `63710c5572`; `origin/main` merged through `os-regen-merge.sh`, and the merge touched no `packages/spec` file)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, the scripts typecheck and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0; test layer OK, 52 / 246 / 135 held.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 648 files, 19395 passed and 1 todo. `test:repo`: 55 files, 971 passed. Both ran at `fbe0be035b`, and `git diff fbe0be035b 63710c5572 -- packages/spec` is empty.
- Consumer typechecks against the rebuilt spec, all exit 0:
  - `@objectstack/runtime` (tsc; test layer 27 / 190 / 68 held);
  - `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` (tsc, scripts tsc, test layer);
  - `@objectstack/trigger-api` (tsc);
  - `@objectstack/http-conformance` (tsc; test layer 3 / 27 / 10 held).
- `check:generated` (14 of 14 current) and `check:api-surface` (unchanged): green at HEAD.
- Gate derivation (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, no paths, at `63710c5572`): 85 commands, of which 83 ran and exited 0. Two are NOT MEASURED by the dispatch's instruction: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (no whole-workspace build) and `check:type-check-debt` (it is the `--re-measure` form). The `--ran` reconciliation reports 85 accounted for, 0 unrun.
- The artifact-roster block from the same derivation: 47 rows ran, 46 at exit 0. Two did not measure:
  - `check:published-readme-exports`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3; 19 unbuilt packages);
  - `check:console-injection`: no console dist, so it skipped at exit 0.
  The three PR-context guards are run against this PR after it opens.

## Acceptance notes

- **Redundant casts.** At `runtime/src/domains/webhooks.ts:114` and `runtime/src/domains/automation-hooks.ts:120`, the cast to `Pick` of the contract's member (or `undefined`) now restates what the lookup answers. Both still compile. Neither file is in this PR. A later edit to either file can drop the cast.
- **Implementers.** Adding required keys to an interface breaks any code that builds an object typed as the whole `ServiceSlotContracts`. There are zero such objects in this repository and in the pinned objectui checkout. The map is read only through `keyof` and indexed access.
- **Stale header sentence.** The header of `contracts/trigger-api-service.ts` still says the `trigger-api` registration "is a separate change: until it lands no kernel fills the slot". `ApiTriggerPlugin` now registers the slot (`plugin.ts:169`). This is outside this PR's file surface and is noted only.
